decisions.reason: It stayed a stand-alone offering through 2024 while several related launches were removed, so it appears to retain enough traction and option value to justify continued support.

Its downgrade from a dedicated page to a mere mention, together with the earlier exit of several similar tariff tools, suggests the firm has learned enough to judge its upside as too limited for further commitment.

Although it was de-emphasized in 2024, it likely has low carrying costs and possible complementarities with the firm’s other location and analytics offerings, so keeping the option open is still worthwhile.
